title: Abbott Elementary
synopsis: There are eleven glue sticks for forty kids and someone unplugged the laminator. It's only Tuesday.

nodes.text: Supply closet: one ream of pink paper, a stapler with no staples, a dehydrated googly eye. The crew films your face.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Civil.
You commit to “Improvise pink-paper week.” The story records the instinct as “Spirit” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Three emojis, zero supplies. The espresso machine in her office hums.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Note the espresso” back. Witness shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

choices.text: Ask for the budget code anyway
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Ask for the budget code anyway” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A pristine pack of construction paper. He's not in yet.

choices.text: Take one pack, leave a note
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take one pack, leave a note” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Petty.

nodes.text: She pretends not to give you 22 markers.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Thank her quietly” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Tease her.” The story records the instinct as “Friend” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Wait — you ARE Janine. Your reflection in the laminator glass says: 'You got this.'

choices.consequence: “Believe yourself” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Spirit.
“Roll your eyes” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: He volunteers to make a TikTok asking parents to donate.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Trust.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: He fixes the laminator without saying anything.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Care.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Marcus, in class, asks why pink is a real color. You discover, live, you don't know.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Make it a project.” The story records the instinct as “Joy” and carries it forward.
“Admit you don't know” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.

nodes.text: She slides a box of bandages your way. 'Just in case,' she says.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Civil—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: You eat at your desk. The crew, mercifully, films the cafeteria instead.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Discipline.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: The janitor says, calmly, that someone took the laminator power cord on purpose.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Investigate” back. Civic shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Let it go” back. Mercy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She tells you she has a 'plan' for supplies. The plan involves a raffle.

choices.consequence: “Indulge her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Strategic.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Marcus's mom calls. She loved Pink Facts.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Invite her in.” The story records the instinct as “Welcome” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Forward—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A glue stick situation in K-2. You are summoned by a tearful aide.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Resolve it sweetly.” The story records the instinct as “Care” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Recruit Mr. Howard.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He brings a fresh ream of paper to your room.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
“Smile and move on” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Civil.

nodes.text: Coffee is terrible. The conversation is good.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

choices.text: Pivot to a plan for next week
choices.consequence: “Pivot to a plan for next week” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Forward.

nodes.text: Marcus shows you a notebook with eighteen perfectly drawn shades of pink.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heart.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Sweet.

nodes.text: On camera: 'How was today?'

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Honestly” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Spirit.

nodes.text: Bell. Hallways thunder. You sit, briefly, in the empty classroom.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Plan tomorrow.” The story records the instinct as “Discipline” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Sit a little longer” back. Quiet shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Pasta. Wine. A bath. Then you fall asleep with the laptop open to a curriculum doc.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
“One more email” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Spirit.

nodes.text: Same closet. Slightly more glue. The googly eye is somehow watching back.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Pink, again.” The story records the instinct as “Joy” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Spirit—follows you into whatever comes next.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: Pink Facts Week becomes a yearly tradition. Marcus, in middle school, still tells people about it.
Ava's raffle, against all odds, raises enough for a year of supplies. You take the credit, then quietly give it to her.
The documentary airs. People recognize you in CVS. You teach. You teach. You teach.
